description_features: Bepanthen Cream is a moisturizing and soothing cream for the skin
Its unique formula helps maintain skin moisture and protects it from dryness, irritation, and inflammation
Contains Dexpanthenol, an active ingredient that aids in skin repair and regeneration, providing a soothing, softening, and moisturizing effect on the skin
usage_instructions: Apply Bepanthen cream once or several times daily as needed
It can be used by pregnant and breastfeeding women
It is preferable to moisturize the face twice a day, once in the morning and once at night, to ensure skin moisture throughout the day
For dry hair tips, a small amount can be applied and gently combed through
benefits: Maintains skin moisture and protects against dryness
Soothes and calms irritated skin
Helps in treating mild burns and sunburn
Effective for rough skin areas (e.g., hands, elbows, feet)
Reduces skin inflammation and rashes
Aids in skin repair and regeneration
Safe and suitable for use on children's skin
Provides relief from irritation and inflammation in sensitive areas
Can alleviate irritation associated with acne (though it's not an acne treatment)
Relieves dryness and inflammation around the lips
Reduces redness and irritation after skin peeling procedures
Does not lighten skin or treat dark circles
For oily skin, it can be used, but for acne-prone skin, lighter, oil-free formulations might be preferable
Visible results for hydration and soothing typically appear within hours; for mild irritation/dryness within 2-3 days; for rashes/wound healing within 5-7 days

technical_challenges_encountered: Website navigation redirects - Some product URLs redirected to category pages instead of product detail pages
Execution context errors - Page navigation and content changes during extraction attempts
Inconsistent product page loading - Some product URLs caused navigation loops
Missing detailed information - Some products lacked comprehensive ingredient lists, customer reviews, or detailed usage instructions
recommendations: Use direct product URLs rather than category navigation for more reliable extraction
Implement retry mechanisms for products that redirect to category pages
Consider alternative extraction methods for products with missing detailed information
Cross-reference product information across multiple attempts for verification
